Fitch downgrades Goodyear to B+ as tire volume declines outpace cost cuts
summary: Investing.com -- Fitch Ratings downgraded Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co's (NASDAQ:GT) long-term issuer default rating to 'B+' from 'BB-', citing persistent volume contraction that continues to overwhelm the manufacturer's turnaround initiatives. While the agency assigned a stable rating outlook on expectations that restructuring will ultimately yield stronger credit metrics, the action underscores the mounting headwinds facing the Akron, Ohio-based tire maker.
